labels.name: ClockFrames

0x080064B8.name: ResetFightState
0x080064B8.note: Clears everything for a new fight: InFight, WinFlag, HalfTimeFlag, the fight clock (ClockMinutes/ClockSeconds = 0, ticks = 60) and ~20 other fight variables. Then per mode: Tournament sets ClockMinutes = 5; Gauntlet Sumo Basho sets 0x01EA54 = 10. Called before a fight starts.

0x08006904.name: FightLoop
0x08006904.note: The in-fight main loop, once per frame until 0x00CCD0 (fight over) is set. Start (bit 3 of 0x00802C) while InFight = 1 opens the pause menu (MenuState 41); choosing quit (MenuState 8) clears WinFlag and leaves. Each frame runs robots/arena/hazards, the Gauntlet logic (sub_080171C0) in mode 3, and the Bash 'n' Dash 1:30 prize check (sub_08016688), then waits for the frame counter at 0x00CC7C and swaps buffers.

0x08006C70.name: UpdateFightClock
0x08006C70.note: Runs the fight clock each game frame (the fight runs at 20 frames a second): ClockFrames goes down 3 per frame in the Gauntlet (real seconds), 7 per frame in other modes (a faster TV-style clock). Stops once WinFlag or 0x00CCD4 is set. At 0:00 sets 0x00CC60 (time up); in single-player Gauntlet that also sets 0x00CCD4 (challenge failed) and starts the result sequence. Also draws the clock (and Drop Zone's counter).

0x08016688.name: BashHalfTimePrize
0x08016688.note: Called by FightLoop in single-player Bash 'n' Dash when the clock reads 1:30 (the half-time prize).

0x080168B4.name: AwardPrize
0x080168B4.note: Awards prize id (0-80) unless already owned: sets its bit in PrizeBits (SaveBlock+0x1C) and plays the unlock sound. Also sets HalfTimeFlag if you are in Bash 'n' Dash at 1:30 and not in multiplayer.

0x0801693C.name: IsPrizeEarned
0x0801693C.note: Returns 1 if prize id's bit is set in PrizeBits.

0x08016990.name: CheatUnlockPrize
0x08016990.note: Session-only unlock: sets the prize bit in SessionPrizeCheats instead of the save.

0x080169D0.name: IsPrizeCheatUnlocked
0x080169D0.note: Returns 1 if prize id's bit is set in SessionPrizeCheats.

0x08017038.name: SetupGauntletChallenge
0x08017038.note: Sets up a Gauntlet challenge. Time limit = byte at 0x083E045F + GauntletChallenge*3 + Difficulty (seconds), split into ClockMinutes/ClockSeconds. Table (Bronze/Silver/Gold): Slalom 15/15/15, Skittles 20/20/20, Long Jump 10/10/10, Sumo Basho 90/60/30, Dump 90/90/90, Drop Zone 90/90/90. Also places your robot for Long Jump and Sumo Basho, and sets 0x021564 from the byte at 0x083E045C + Difficulty (used by Drop Zone's on-screen counter).

0x080171C0.name: GauntletFrame
0x080171C0.note: Called every frame by FightLoop when CurrentMode = 3 (Gauntlet). Reads WinFlag in 6 places: the per-challenge win/fail logic.

0x08017674.name: PlaySound
0x08017674.note: Plays sound effect id (arg1) through the sound driver (sub_0810DBE4), using the byte at 0x027871 (probably the sound effects volume setting). AwardPrize calls it for the unlock jingle.

0x08023714.name: UnlockAllSecrets
0x08023714.note: With argument 1, loops AwardPrize over every prize 0-80 (the Unlock All Secrets option).

0x08023C74.name: OnDifficultyChosen
0x08023C74.note: Menu callback (reached through a function pointer): stores the chosen difficulty in Difficulty (and 0x0271B4). In Mayhem / Bash 'n' Dash on Gold, checks the arena's best medal in MayhemProgress / BashProgress. Sets 0x027A6C = 1 and returns screen 0x19.

0x0802539C.name: AwardSpoilAfterWin
0x0802539C.note: If WinFlag is 1, awards the prize stored in the current SpoilsTable entry (multiplayer spoils).

0x08025F48.name: IsPrizeAvailable
0x08025F48.note: Returns 1 if prize id (0-80) is owned: earned in the save (IsPrizeEarned) or unlocked by a cheat this session (IsPrizeCheatUnlocked). Used ~50 places to decide which parts/robots/arenas you can pick.

0x08027E54.name: ScreenManager
0x08027E54.note: The game's screen state machine (confirmed live in mGBA: it changed MenuState 3 -> 4 when leaving the language screen). Loops forever: MenuState = sub_08027A1C(MenuState, screen table 0x083E2768, ...), so each screen's code returns the id of the next screen. Also handles the end of a multiplayer fight: awards the spoil you won from SpoilsTable unless it is 81 (none), then goes to screen 15, 54 or 55. Called at boot (sub_08004D24) and by FightLoop for the pause menu.

0x08028504.name: PlayMenuSound
0x08028504.note: Shortcut for PlaySound(id) with default settings. Called from the menu screens (cursor moves, confirm/back).

0x0802E8A0.name: AwardQueuedPrizes
0x0802E8A0.note: Walks the queue of prizes earned by the reward rules and calls AwardPrize on each.
